subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should OpenClaw accept a repaired 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as the first product slice for the linked calendar request, or require broader calendar/week/editing scope before landing?
rationale: This is a new user-facing Control UI feature that implements only part of the linked request and now needs product-scope confirmation plus a substantial rebase before technical repair is worth doing.

options.title: Accept Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Rebase this feature onto the current Cron page and fix the scheduler/status/i18n blockers while tracking daily/week/editing scope separately.

options.title: Hold For Full Calendar Design
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define the daily, weekly, quick-stat, drag-and-drop, and validation behavior as one product surface.

options.title: Defer Core Timeline
options.body: Keep the existing list/run-history UI as the core experience for now and close or defer this implementation after documenting the decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Rebase this feature onto the current Cron page and fix the scheduler/status/i18n blockers while tracking daily/week/editing scope separately.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest recent Control UI view-surface ownership signal among the likely owners, so they are the best routing candidate for the product-scope choice.
